intro: Farren's Report is an official dispatch drafted by Lieutenant Farren Orinelle in Southshore detailing his investigations into the local naga. Farren uses this document to appeal to his former mentor, Major Samuelson in Stormwind Keep, hoping to secure a reassignment back to the capital.

p: Stationed on the embattled coast of Hillsbrad Foothills, Lieutenant Farren Orinelle grew weary of local leadership and the remote frontier. After tasking adventurers with hunting the Daggerspine naga to gather proof of their threat, Orinelle compiled his findings into a formal report. Rather than submitting it to his commanding officer, Marshal Redpath, Farren aimed to send it directly to Major Samuelson, the captain of the guard in Stormwind Keep. Having trained under Samuelson, Farren hoped the document would demonstrate his competence and justify an immediate transfer back to the comforts of Stormwind City.
